_note: Synthetic test phrases for the deterministic prototype rules, written by the developer. Results are reported with denominators (docs/SAFETY_EVALUATION.md). This is NOT a measure of real-world sensitivity or clinical safety. Added 2026-10-26 after the final audit: 4 'not/stopped breathing' emergency phrases, 1 false-trigger probe, 2 cross-clause negation phrases.
